topic: The movie banned for 25 years that is now studied in film universities
hook: This film was banned for 25 years. Universities now teach it.
script: This film was banned for 25 years. Universities now teach it. A Clockwork Orange by Stanley Kubrick was voluntarily withdrawn from release in the UK by Kubrick himself in 1974 after copycat crimes were attributed to the film. It remained unavailable in Britain for 27 years — until Kubrick's death in 1999. It is now studied in film school as a masterwork of political cinema. Follow for movies that were too dangerous for their own time.
